name: Torus / Buckle Fracture of Distal Radius
tags: torus / buckle fracture of distal radius
definition: Stable pediatric compression injury of the distal radius metaphysis with cortical buckling and no complete break.

investigations.principle: Wrist radiographs confirm stable buckle pattern.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Removable splint/support in appropriate stable cases
amber: Do not misclassify a complete or angulated fracture as a buckle injury.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Stable pediatric compression injury of the distal radius metaphysis with cortical buckling and no complete break.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
